PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 4, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  COMMISSION@LBUTILITIES.ORG

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  25-57054  Recommendation to approve November 20, 2025 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

REGULAR AGENDA

2.  25-57055  Recommendation to receive and file the State Water Project Supply Overview.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-57126  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. UT-1545 authorizing the General
  Manager to execute a contract, and any necessary documents including any
  necessary subsequent amendments, with Ocean Blue Environmental Services,
  Inc., of Long Beach, California, for providing as-needed hazardous waste removal
  services on the same terms and conditions afforded to the City of Pasadena,
  California (Contract No. 32722), in an annual amount not to exceed $1,000,000,
  until the City of Pasadena contract expires on September 28, 2026, with the option
  to renew for as long as the City of Pasadena contract remains in effect.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-57135  Recommendation to receive and file the November 20, 2025 Resources
  Committee Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
